Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD, AJAY RASTOGI, HEMANT GUPTA
Compensation: Motor Accident – claim for compensation – Tribunal taking the monthly income of deceased as Rs. 9000/- p.m. awarded compensation of Rs. 20,11,000/- – High Court in appeal enhanced the compensation to Rs. 33,07,000/-, by taking the monthly income of deceased as Appeal to Supreme Court – Held: The salary certificate of the deceased indicated that his monthly salary was Rs. 23,419/- p.m.– Therefore, compensation awarded by High Court is enhanced to Rs. 45,29,000/-, with interest at 9% p.a. from the date of filing of claim petition until
Decision Date : 05-06-2020 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2511/2020 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
